answer: Seed trust in a few long-lived agents and let it flow outward by short random walks over the attestation graph, SybilRank style. Honest agents form an open meadow of cross-links, so trust reaches them in a few steps. A sybil farm is a tight spiral of keys vouching for each other with only a handful of edges to real agents; those thin bridges choke the flow, so a thousand fresh keys share the trust of one. A cluster that appears overnight like a comet earns almost nothing until it builds real edges.
